Discovery Engagement Proposal
Scope: Four weeks of discovery: current-state process map, prioritized backlog, and implementation recommendation.
Commercial Offer: 80 hours at $200/hour, total $16,000. Payment: 50% ($8,000) at kickoff, 50% ($8,000) on delivery of artifacts.
Exclusions: Implementation, integrations, production support, and guaranteed savings are excluded.
Client Responsibilities: Supply interview access and source documents.
Start Date: Agreed only after signature and designation of a named client contact.
Acceptance: Sponsor confirms delivery of the three listed artifacts.

How to Proceed:
1. Review and sign this proposal.
2. Designate a named client contact.
3. Return signed agreement to initiate scheduling.
Upon receipt of signed proposal and contact name, the engagement will commence within two weeks.
